t: This is Broadwick Street, a short Soho street of under two-tenths of a mile, running between Marshall Street and Wardour Street and crossing Berwick Street. It is tied to the poet and artist William Blake, who lived here at three points in his life: from his birth in 1757 until 1782, again in 1784 and 1785, and briefly in 1803. His father James and his elder brother, also James, lived here too. Blake spent nearly all his life in London, apart from three years in Felpham.
